name: upsc-mentor-server
description: Backend for the UPSC mentor app. Holds the Anthropic key, serves versioned rubrics, enforces spend caps.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && mkdir -p dist/rubrics dist/mcq/prompts dist/ca/prompts dist/drills/prompts dist/interview/prompts && cp src/rubrics/*.md dist/rubrics/ && cp src/mcq/prompts/*.md dist/mcq/prompts/ && cp src/ca/prompts/*.md dist/ca/prompts/ && cp src/ca/sources.json dist/ca/ && cp src/drills/prompts/*.md dist/drills/prompts/ && cp src/interview/prompts/*.md dist/interview/prompts/
